parakeet: So, a Pew research study done on religious knowledge revealed that Christians, both Protestant and Catholic, scored the absolute lowest in a religious knowledge survey, and atheists and agnostics scored the absolute highest with Jews and Mormons coming right under. I think what many people failed to understand, especially the Christians in my comments, is that one of the major contributions to atheism and agnosticism is biblical literacy. Many of the believers that I know lack the interest to read the book from cover to cover and the integrity to verify its claims. Just wanted to share that.
